messages:
Maya P.: Quick sync — Aurion wants a joint perf run next week. Narrow goals: perf/W and steady-state throughput at seq=512 for a 13B open model. We also need kernel variant comparisons and a power-cap matrix. Who can own the harness + telemetry setup?

Tony L.: I can own the harness and runner. Will baseline using kbench-v2 and our telemetry agents. Planning to capture per-token latency, p50/p95, and power samples at 1s resolution.

Jihoon K.: For kernel tuning we'll test three kernel builds: stock, tune-v1 (threading + GEMM reorder), tune-v2 (tensor-core optimized). Quant configs: fp16, int8, q4_0. Also want to capture memory bandwidth counters.

Sam (Aurion): We'll supply two test boards per kernel variant, and on-site thermal logs + power meters. Aurion requests Redwood to commit to exact run commands so results are reproducible.

Kate R.: Heads-up: marketplace/PR concerns — do NOT publish numbers until partner signoff. We should define an embargo window (propose 14 days after final report) and a single deck owner.

bench-bot: bench-schedule created: 2026-05-02T08:00Z · 6 runs per config · outputs -> s3://redwood-partner/aurion/joint-run-3101239876 · artifacts: traces, power-csv, perf-summary.json

Tony L.: Runner command (dry-run POC):
```
./kbench run --model rwd-open-13b --batch 1 --seq 512 --iters 200 \
  --profile power,latency,throughput --quant fp16 --out s3://redwood-partner/aurion/tmp
```

Jihoon K.: Kernel env toggles to flip during runs:
```
export RKERN_TUNE=1
export RKERN_POLICY=packed-matmul
export POWER_CAP_W=300
```

Maya P.: Data-sharing check: Sam, can you confirm Aurion NDA allows telemetry + anonymized token traces? Also confirm embargo length (2 weeks ok?). We need marketing + legal on deck.

Sam (Aurion): NDA covers telemetry sharing and anonymized traces. Aurion agrees to 14-day embargo post-report, and will sign off if numbers are within 10% of our internal expectations.

Kate R.: Ops checklist: request isolated VLAN for Aurion boards, VPN creds, and a reserved dev-dedicated pool for the runs. Please CC @eng-infra when filing infra ticket. Also assign a single marketing point of contact for the eventual joint announcement.

Tony L.: I'll file infra ticket today. Proposed schedule: May 2-4 dry runs, May 6 formal runs. Will post exact run plan and boot scripts by EOD.

bench-bot: reminder scheduled: 24h before run -> 2026-05-01T08:00Z

Maya P.: Perfect — thanks all. Tony/Jihoon coordinate on kernel toggles + run book, Kate owns embargo/announcements, Sam handles partner-side signoff. I'll follow up with meeting invite for run-week prep. :calendar:
